remarks: Welcome to 9651 Deerview Ln, an exceptional Essex-built Colonial perfectly positioned on a quiet cul-de-sac in sought-after Clarence Center. Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, this impressive 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence blends timeless elegance, quality craftsmanship, and modern comfort. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into an open, light-filled interior featuring 9’ ceilings, beautifully refinished hardwood floors, and sophisticated neutral finishes throughout. At the heart of the home, the expansive eat-in kitchen features Corian countertops, a center island, breakfast bar, pantry, workstation, stainless steel appliances (2022), and a stunning morning room with cathedral ceiling. The elegant great room is designed to impress with a tray ceiling, gas fireplace, and recessed lighting. A formal dining room provides the perfect setting for entertaining, while the private den/office features custom built-ins and a permanent wall safe. A well-appointed mudroom and first-floor laundry add convenience and functionality. Upstairs, retreat to the spacious primary suite complete with a walk-in closet and beautifully renovated spa-inspired bath (2026), showcasing dual vanities, a soaking tub, and oversized shower. Two additional generously sized bedrooms and a full bath complete the second level. Outdoors, enjoy a private backyard retreat featuring a Trex deck and metal gazebo, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Additional highlights include a stately brick front, side-load 2.5-car garage, shed, 8’ basement ceilings with glass block windows, furnace and central air (2021, serviced 2026), two hot water tanks, ceilings repainted in 2026, and hardwood floors refinished May 2026. Impeccably maintained and truly move-in ready, this exceptional Clarence Center residence offers an outstanding combination of elegance, comfort, and location near parks, bike paths, shopping, and Clarence Schools.
